recovery.scope: Restore distinct typed records in all28 remaining card functions with synthetic unions. A conservative C statement CFG associates every reference with reaching initializer sites; all syntactic paths have a known constructor, without an event-satisfiability assumption. Same-kind initializers feeding a common use are grouped; three functions have several initializer paths for a single native local. Native common-frame declarations provide record counts and vocabulary. Record declarations cover all source uses, with function lifetime for any syntactic pointer alias. Exact offset/width projections replace cross-view fields and complete little-endian byte groups; other expressions, constants, calls and control flow are retained except for the recorded Najeela and Biomancer event dispatch rewrites. Native variable-name ordering is a candidate mapping that must be checked against scoped native/rebuilt stores. Geometry/event matches alone do not prove unknown values, all aliases or complete gameplay. Declaration geometry checks the unchanged baseline typed/array locals plus all83 restored native common-frame records. Five split-card functions already reuse other same-kind target locals across native inline scopes; their additional native declarations are outside this union pass, not falsely credited as restored. Scalar profiles exclude strictly contained same-frame record scopes from broader lexical profiles, and match all83 restored declaration profiles one-to-one; this is not a unique variable identity or initializer-argument provenance proof. Filter scalar checks cover offsets100..215. One duplicated compiled store group is accepted only after corresponding store sites are proven mutually unreachable.

limits: Statement CFG discovery models every syntactic successor and known constructor site, with parser typedef stubs; it is not a complete C type/alias analysis. Store profiles exclude contained same-frame scopes; profile matching and equal unknown values do not prove unique variable identity or initializer argument provenance. Five split-card functions retain baseline reuse of other same-kind targets across inline scopes, outside this union queue. Unions in pointed-to objects/members, all indirect/indexed values, callee retention, arbitrary aliases, other compiler configurations and complete gameplay remain open. No fresh whole-DLL reccmp score is claimed.
